notes.content:
Please continue to test and let us know if you find issues related to performance or gameplay.

Thanks! :)

notes.title: Reverting latest Update for a few days to fix a performance issue.
New Update Released!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0m_QNpeG3tA

Please report any issues you encounter on the Community Forum or Discord, we'll really appreciate your help finding issues in the new update.

New features:
- All new characters!
- Character reactions
- All new environment design and textures
- Fixes to cutting mechanics (now super smooth and easy to use)
- Added extra charge to the clipper
- Added more time to the timer (no more rushing)
- Lowered prices of all purchasable
- Hair wash station now unlocked since the beginning
- Tons of bug fixes & improvements

notes.title: Prepare for a Major Update!
notes.content:
Hi Virtual Barbers!

A new big update is under development and coming soon!

What to Expect:
- Full re-modeling of the game, with new 3d models and textures
- More forgiving mechanics (more time, easier cutting)
- Washing station is no longer locked
- Can try everything in Sandbox mode
- In addition to the current Comb there will be a new Bigger Brush tool
- Bug fixes (like some hair strands missing randomly)
- Client character reactions
- And More!
